forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular imports make module load order fragile. Baseline 109 (barrel index files); ratchet to error once the barrels are split.

forbidden.name: services-no-routes
forbidden.comment: Services must not import the Express route layer (tests excepted).

forbidden.name: utils-no-routes
forbidden.comment: src/utils is a leaf library; importing the route layer inverts the dependency direction.

forbidden.name: utils-no-services
forbidden.comment: src/utils is a leaf library; importing services from it inverts the dependency direction.

forbidden.name: providers-no-services
forbidden.comment: Provider adapters should depend on utils/config, not on services.

forbidden.name: routes-no-routes
forbidden.comment: Route modules should share helpers via src/routes/utils or src/utils, not import each other.
